description: This file defines the DocumentSoap class which provides methods for handling document uploads via SOAP in the SuiteCRM system. It includes functionality for saving files, handling file decoding, versioning, and interacting with the Document and DocumentRevision beans.

classes.name: DocumentSoap
classes.description: A class providing SOAP-based file upload and document management functionalities within SuiteCRM, including file decoding, revision handling, and saving logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new UploadFile instance for handling the file upload process.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Handles the process of saving a document file, decoding base64 content, creating a new document revision, and updating the Document record.
